premise: The wind blows Butterfly away from Flower; Deer lets her ride on his nose and walks her slowly all the way back.
inspiration: The folk tale of the leaf carried off by the wind, turned: a gentle giant carries the small one home against it.
lesson: Being big means you can carry someone small home.

en-US.title: Butterfly in the Wind
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly came fluttering over the meadow to visit her friend {flower:enter} Flower. {flower:face happy} {butterfly:go to flower} Every morning she said hello. But today… {canvas:wind 0.8 26s} {sfx:gust} WHOOSH! A big wind came blowing. [surprised] Butterfly {butterfly:go to branches} {butterfly:spin} tumbled up and away, past the trees. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] Flower! I can't get back! {flower:face sad} Flower {flower:live hold} folded her yellow petals up tight against the wind, and waited. Along came {deer:enter} Deer on his long legs. {deer:live} He lowered his head to nibble the grass, lifted it, flicked his ears… and saw her. {deer:face happy} [softly] {butterfly:go on deer} Land on my nose, he said. So Butterfly landed, {butterfly:live hold} closed her wings together and held on. And Deer {deer:go to flower} {butterfly:go on deer} walked, slowly, carefully, step… by… step, {deer:pulse x2} into the wind, all the way back. When the wind had gone, he bent his head down low beside Flower. {flower:live resume} Flower opened her petals wide. {butterfly:live resume} Butterfly opened her wings and {butterfly:go to flower} fluttered happily down. {butterfly:face happy} {flower:face happy} [happily] Hello, said Butterfly. I came the long way round. {deer:glow}

es-ES.title: Mariposa y el viento
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Mariposa llegó revoloteando por el prado a visitar a su amiga {flower:enter} Flor. {flower:face happy} {butterfly:go to flower} Cada mañana le decía hola. Pero hoy… {canvas:wind 0.8 26s} {sfx:gust} ¡FIUUU! Un viento fuerte entró soplando. [surprised] Mariposa {butterfly:go to branches} {butterfly:spin} salió volando, lejos, más allá de los árboles. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] ¡Flor! ¡No puedo volver! {flower:face sad} Flor {flower:live hold} cerró sus pétalos amarillos bien apretados contra el viento, y esperó. Por allí pasaba {deer:enter} Ciervo con sus patas largas. {deer:live} Bajó la cabeza a mordisquear la hierba, la levantó, movió las orejas… y la vio. {deer:face happy} [softly] {butterfly:go on deer} Pósate en mi nariz, le dijo. Mariposa se posó, {butterfly:live hold} juntó sus alas y se agarró fuerte. Y Ciervo {deer:go to flower} {butterfly:go on deer} caminó despacio, con cuidado, paso… a… paso, {deer:pulse x2} contra el viento, de vuelta. Cuando el viento se fue, bajó la cabeza junto a Flor. {flower:live resume} Flor abrió sus pétalos de par en par. {butterfly:live resume} Mariposa abrió las alas y {butterfly:go to flower} bajó revoloteando, contenta. {butterfly:face happy} {flower:face happy} [happily] Hola, dijo Mariposa.
